feeds.title: Uptown Doula Blog
feeds.description: Haley Jasmin talks about her experience and the skills she's learned as a Certified Doula. Her team of experienced doulas will understand your physical and emotional needs and ensure you get the support structure that meets the needs of your growing family. Browse informative articles on Pregnancy, Breast-feeding, Postpartum care and more categories.

feeds.title: Peanut Butter Runner
feeds.description: Peanut Butter Runner shres fitness tips, health advice and more. I'm Jen and I'm a yoga teacher, fitness professional, and mom to a toddler and two dogs. I live in Charlotte, NC, and share daily updates about food, fitness, yoga, and life.

feeds.title: Carolina Charm
feeds.description: Hello, I'm Christina, the author behind Carolina Charm. I'm the wife to Matt and a coffee-fueled mama to Caroline and Thomas. This is a space for me to share the moments that make my mama's heart spill over, a mix of recipes, and more. My hope is you will find something in this space that encourages, entertains or inspires you.

feeds.title: Stilettos & Diapers
feeds.description: Stillettos & Diaper by Molly Wey is a blog narrating Molly's life as a Mom and an Entrepreneur. Read articles on Family, Motherhood, fashion, Travel, Recipes and more. Molly loves cooking, wine, and all kinds of crafty projects, and likes to share them here.

feeds.title: Miranda in Charlotte
feeds.description: Miranda in Charlotte in Charlotte is a blog by Miranda Miller where she shares her story of a southern girl living in Queen City, the jobs she worked, and Her family and business. She writes and posts about beauty decor fashion and parenting among other topics.

feeds.title: Daily With Bailey
feeds.description: Daily With Bailey is a fashion and lifestyle blog based in Charlotte, NC, providing daily inspiration for fashion, travel, beauty, and healthy living. Hi! My name is Bailey Schwartz, and I am the creator and editor behind Daily With Bailey, a fashion and lifestyle blog that I started in 2016 as a passion project for expressing my creativity and love of fashion.

feeds.title: The Charlotte Moms
feeds.description: The Charlotte Moms Community guide lists attraction activities, and events, Parenting tips and more. If you're looking for a destination with activities and attractions to keep everyone happy, Charlotte is the place. Explore the best of Charlotte City with this blog.
